name: Benewake TF-Luna
description: Single-point 850 nm VCSEL time-of-flight distance sensor, 0.2–8 m, UART/I²C at 3.3 V logic.

specs.label: Range
specs.value: 0.2–8 m @ 90% reflectivity, 0.2–2.5 m @ 10% (indoor and 90 klx outdoor)

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: UART (115200 default) / I²C (addr 0x10, 400 kbps) / I/O; LVTTL 3.3 V

specs.label: Weight
specs.value: <5 g; ABS+PC housing; no ingress rating

envelope.axes: x = length across both mounting ears, y = height of the front face, z = depth along the optical axis incl. lens bosses (datasheet says 12.5; drawing shows 13.5 overall, 12 body)

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 2× Ø2.2 through holes in side ears (R2.25), 30.5 mm centre-to-centre, symmetric about the centre.

features.label: Lenses
features.value: Two Ø10.5 lenses (emitter/receiver), centres 10.5 mm apart, symmetric about the centre; lens centres 9 mm from the top edge of the front face. Body flanks 18 / 26.5 wide at the lens boss; ear tabs 2 mm thick (front view '2').

features.label: Connector
features.value: 6-pin 1.25 mm-pitch connector on the rear/top face; side view shows connector at 6.8 from the base.

features.label: Back face
features.value: Rear PCB outline 19 mm tall inside the 21.25 housing.

amazon.title: Benewake TF-Luna LiDAR Module Range Finder Sensor Single-Point Micro Ranging Module for Arduino Pixhawk 5V UART IIC Interface

notes: Height conflict: datasheet A05 gives 35 × 21.25 × 12.5 mm (L×W×H) while the manual drawing shows 13.5 overall (12 body) — modelled envelope uses 13.5. Which ear-hole row lies on the lens axis is not dimensioned; drawing reading is approximate for the 9 mm lens offset. Amazon B086MJQSLR title matches; seller not confirmed (page truncated).
